items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-15
items.q: Because we was playing at, uh, at, uh, Humming Booth, at, uh, Elite... Well, George was playing a lot of clarinet then.

ctx.x: And who took up on clarinet after that? Who would you say? Well, I'm not. Oh, but any, was anybody on clarinet?
Yeah, George Lewis. You'd say he was the king?
Yeah, he was, he was about to next to me. He was George Lewis. When did George Lewis start coming in the public eye, would you say?
